lead: A go-to-definition case answers only for an expression at file scope, and only for an `is` test the checker did not settle.
body: `crates/nvs-lsp/src/definition.rs`'s `jump` helper answered `none` for `$b->area()` and `new Square()` written inside a `function` body while the same expressions at file scope answered, and `$s is Shape` over a `Square`-typed subject folds to a constant that leaves no node to navigate from. Write the subject as a `mixed` local at file scope, and keep the tested class one the declaration cannot settle.
